tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (a)༄༅/ /mi mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan mchog rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/na rot+tam su tau tsas hairnām pa ra ma rat+na
(a)༄༅/ /mi mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan mchog rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/na rot+tam su tau tsas hairnām pa ra ma rat+na

tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// mi mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan mchog rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ na rot+tam su tau tsas hairnām pa ra ma rat+nā ba li nā ma/ bod skad du/ mi mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan mchog rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ snang byed 'bum phrag dkyil nas phyung ltar dge mtshan phun tshogs lham mer ngom pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// rab 'bar snang bas mun stug ji bzhin lus can sgrib gsum lhag med za ba dam pa'i chos// 'od srungs byin ltar gzhan don bzod pa'i khur chen khyer la gzhar yang ngal min 'phags pa'i tshogs// gang dag skyabs su nges par bzung tsam bslu min yon tan bsam yas dkon mchog gsum la 'dud// zla bral mi mchog rnams kyi mtshan bzang yi ge dam pa'i dun+dhu bhiḥ// dad pa'i dbyi gus bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs thos pa 'dzin pa'i bcud len nam// ro 'dzin zlos pa'i gar du bsgyur ram yid kyi rtsig ngos yangs par 'dri// de de'i skye ba'i sgrib pa rnam sbyong bde ster tshig gi me tog bstar// de la thog mar byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba bshags pa las 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga'i mtshan gyi phreng ba ni/ bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib tshogs kyi// dgra mngon bcom pa shākya thub// yang dag rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis// mtshan rtog 'joms pa rdo rje'i snying*// gang la ci 'dod yon tan gyi// rin chen 'od zer ring por 'phro// mkhyen brtse'i char gyis dge legs kyi// lo tog skyed pa klu dbang rgyal// mtshan tsam 'dzin pas mi mthun phyogs// 'joms pa'i mthu ldan dpa' bo'i sde// mi bzad bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis// gzhom du med pa'i dpa' bar dgyes// 'jig rten kun gyi mi shes pa'i// mun pa mthar mdzad rin chen me// kun dkris tsha bas gdungs pa rnams// bsil byed rin chen zla ba'i 'od// sems can yongs kyi re ba dag

/'gengs byed mthong ba don yod dpal// 'bad pa med pa'i phrin las kyis// gdung ba sel mdzad rin chen zla// dri bcas sems kyi glo bur ba// rnam par sbyong ba dri ma med// dge ba'i lam gyis dub pa rnams// dbugs rab 'byin pa dpa' ba sbyin// sgrib pa kun gyis spangs gyur kyang*// yon tan gyis 'khyud tshangs pa che// dkar min las dang nyes ltung tshogs// dran pas dag byed tshangs pas byin// mngon par rgyags pas mkhregs pa'i rgyud// yongs su brlan pa chu yi lha// dri med ye shes rgyun gtsang gis// 'gro rgyud bran pa chu lha'i lha// don gnyis phun tshogs go 'phang gi /rtse mor gshegs pa dpal bzang pa// lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las kyis// 'jig rten kun khyab tsan+dan dpal// mtshan dang dpe byad snang ba yis// nam mkha'i mthar 'byams gzi mtha' yas// sgrib pas dben pa'i ye shes kyi// gzigs pa rab gsal 'od kyi dpal// srid pa gsum gyi zug rngu dag /drung nas rnam 'byin mya ngan med// gang gi mthu yis lus med stobs// rnam par nyams byed sred med bu// mtshan bzang 'bar bas 'jig rten kun// rab dga'i dpal ster me tog dpal// rnam dag ye shes tshangs pa yi// 'od zer rnam rol mngon par mkhyen// yon tan rab rgyas pad+ma yi// 'od zer rnam rol mngon par mkhyen// 'phags nor bdun gyi 'byor pa la// sems can kun 'god nor gyi dpal// lus dang tshor ba chos sems sogs// yon tan mang 'dzin dran pa'i dpal// sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyan mchog gi /mtshan dpal shin tu yongs grags dpal// mngon par shes dang dad sogs kyi// dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal// kun du rtogs pa'i dgra sde rnams// shin tu rnam par gnon pa'i dpal// mi bzad bdud dang nyon mongs kyi// g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal// lta ba ngan pa'i ri bo dag /rab bsnyil rnam par gnon pas gshegs// zad mi shes pa'i yon tan gyi// kun nas snang ba bkod pa'i dpal// re ba skong yang kun rtog bral// rin chen pad+mas rnam par gnon// kun rtog dri yi bzhon pa yis// rnam par mi g.yo ri dbang rgyal// zhes so//

༈ /dpang skong phyag brgya pa nas 'byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan gyis// 'gro ba'i re skong rin chen 'byung*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi /zug rngu rnam 'joms mya ngan med// ci 'dod yon tan phrin las kyis// nam mkha'i mthar 'gro rin chen 'od// bdag tu lta ba'i dgra tshogs kyi// mgo 'phang dmad pa rgyal ba'i dbyangs// rtag tu gzhan phan dgongs pa can// ting 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal// 'jig rten don mdzad 'jig rten gyi// skyon bral pad+mo dam pa'i dpal// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan mchog gi /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa'i dpal// 'khor ba'i tshad gdung yongs skyob pa'i// dmigs med snying rje'i gdugs dam pa// srid gsum phan bde'i 'dab ma stong*// bzhad pa'i rtsa lag pad+mo'i dpal// mkhyen brtse'i snang ba dpag yas kyis// 'jig rten 'gengs pa dga' ba'i dpal/ ༈ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba nas 'byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan ni/ shar phyogs nyon mongs bskyod pa na// bzhugs pa'i 'gro 'dul rjes su skyong*// lho phyogs mun pa bcom pa yi// bsnyengs bral mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal// nub phyogs yul khams phebs pa yi// khon dang rgyags pa rnam par gnon// byang phyogs spobs pa can gyi mgon// rin chen gzugs bkod 'od rab snang*// byang shar bdud sde bcom pa yi// bdud dang yid gnyis 'joms pa'i stobs// shar lho rtag tu snang ba yi// mi ldog 'khor lo 'byung ba'i dpal// lho nub gser drwas g.yogs pa yi// sangs rgyas rin chen gdugs 'phags snang*// nub byang rab gnas mngon 'phags kyi// mgon po byang chub sems dpa' 'dul// steng phyogs dmigs pa med pa yi// mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal// 'og phyogs yon tan kun brgyan par// bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba nyon mongs skyod/

༈ /'phags pa me tog gi tshogs kyi bkod pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas brgya dang nyer gsum gyi mtshan rin po che'i phreng ba ni/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin de la// bde legs rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas// grangs med tshogs kyang skad cig nyid// rdzogs byed rin chen dam pa'i dpal// gang la ci 'dod phrin las kyi// bsams kun rdzogs pa'i rin chen 'byung*// 'khor ba'i mun pa drung 'byin ched// gzi byin 'bar ba rin chen snang*// khams gsum kun du ches lam gyis// phongs pa sel ba'i rin chen tog /'gro la gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan// dri med rin chen rab tu snang*// mtshan tsam rna bar ltung bas kyang*// ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gegs mi 'khrugs pa// gang 'tsham chos kyi snang ba yis// 'jig rten 'gengs pa 'od chen po// mi zad gsung gi gsang ba'i dpal// nam mkha'i mtha' 'byams dbyangs dpag med// nyon mongs nad kyi zung rngu dag /drung nas 'byin pa bdud rtsi'i dbyangs// gang mtshan snyan pas bsrungs pa'i phyogs// bdud las rgyal byed grags pa che// che mchog yon tan sgrogs pa'i rnga// sa gsum ldir ba grags mtha' yas// ye shes gzigs pas sems can khams// 'jug par mi g.yel rin chen snang*// mkhyen brtse nus pas duḥkha las// sgrol mdzad bde ba chen po thob// bag chags bcas pa'i ma rig mun// sel ba'i skar ma mar me snang*// sdug bsngal rgyur bcas nyen pa la// 'gog lam ston pa bden pa'i dbyangs// 'bad pa med pa'i phrin las rgyun// ma 'gags dri med pha mtha' yas// bdag dang phung po kun rtog gi /sgrib bral zla ba lta bur dkar// las nyon tsha bas gdungs pa'i dbal// bsil byed thugs rje'i zla ba'i 'od// sum cu rtsa gnyis dge mtshan dpyid// ring por snang ba dri med 'od// sems can don du sgyu 'phrul gyi// drwa ba rab 'phro 'od dag pa// phan dang bde ba'i 'dab ma stong*// rgyas pa'i rtsa lag nyi ma'i 'od// gnas dang gnas min mkhyen la sogs// yon tan rin chen gting mtha' yas// srid par gzhan gyi don gzhol yang*// srid pa'i skyon bral pad+ma'i bla// ting nge 'dzin sogs byang chub lam// yang dag yan lag bla mar grags// bsod nams brgya phrag gis bskyed sku// dri med gser gyi 'od dam pa// don gnyis grub pa'i go 'phang gi

/yang rtser phyin pa'i dbang phyug rgyal// sems can ma lus bsam pa kun// rdzogs par byed pa gser ltar snang*// gang la ci 'dod nyer stsol ba'i// yon tan rin chen gser 'byung gnas// 'gro rgyud dge ba'i lo thog 'od// smin byed klu yi dbang phyug rgyal// 'jig rten mdzes pa'i me tog ni// kun gyi dri yi dbang phyug rgyal// su zhig grags pa'i dri bsung gis// reg pa bde sbyin sā la'i rgyal// mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i dpa' brtan gyi// sde dang mtshon chas nyon mongs sel// bgrang las 'das pa'i tshogs zung gis// legs bskyed dpal gyi snying po snang*// rnam gsum tshul khrims ngad ldan par// 'gro rnams 'god pa'i spos dpag med// bdag med chos kyi rnga sgra yis// gdul bya'i gnyid 'phrog seng ge'i dbyangs// sngon rabs thugs bskyed snying stobs kyi// mthu chen brtson pas nges par 'byung*// lha mi'i dpal dang theg gzhan gyi// byang chub snying po zil gyis gnon// rnam par mi rtog chos kyi sgra// kun du khyab pa'i rnga dbyangs rgyal// dge legs ku mud 'dab ma stong*// kha 'byed zla ba'i bla ma nyid// mtshan gyi me tog rgyas gang gis// 'jig rten me tog zil gyis gnon// skye dgu yongs kyi ma rig mun// mthar mdzad 'jig rten sgron ma che// khams gsum 'gro ba'i nyon mongs kyi// bud shing za byed sangs rgyas me// gang la ci 'dod stsol ba'i phyag /ring por rkyong ba rin chen rmad// srid zhi'i mtha' chen gnyis las brgal// rtag par yongs su mya ngan 'das// rnam par rtog pa'i rdul phran yang*// spangs gyur zug rngu med pa'i blo// 'gro ba 'dul pa'i thabs mkhas gzugs// sna tshogs sprul pa tshad med snang*// gang thugs ye shes rdo rje yis// lta ngan ri bo rnam par gnon// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i shugs// mi dman rin chen glang po'i mchog

/mtshan tsam 'dzin pas 'gro ba yi// re skong rin chen 'dus pa'i dpal// gang la skyabs song byang chub las// mi ldog 'khor lo rin chen dpal// chos kyi dbyings las gang 'dul gzugs// grangs med snang ba rnam dag thob// mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun// 'gengs pa'i nyi zla sgron ma che// kun du rtog pa'i 'thor rlung gis// rnam par mi g.yo ri bo'i rab// bdud bzhi'i dpung gis mi phyed pa'i// dpa' zhing brtan pa ri rab mthong*// las nyon sgrib pa'i rlung chen gyi// rgyu ba 'gog byed ri bo 'dra// rnam gsum tshul khrims ngad ldan du// lus can 'god pa kun du spos// srid zhi'i mtha' las brgal ba'i lam// legs 'doms snang ba yongs su dag /rigs can gsum po rang rang gi /byang chub la 'god chos kyi bla// byang chub yan lag bdun gyi lam// legs 'doms spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// kun nas rdzogs pa'i yon tan che// rdzu 'phrul rlung gis phrin las dri// kun du khyer ba spos kyi 'od// sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul gzugs// kun du snang ba'i 'od zer 'phro// mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku// dge mtshan 'bar ba 'od tshad med// 'jig rten kun la nyin dang mtshan// lan drug gzigs pa'i 'od btang ba// sdug bsngal kun 'byung tsha ba'i dbal// 'phrog phyir zla ba'i sgron mar grags// mtshan tsam thos pas bsod nams kyi// chu dbang rgyas pa zla ba'i 'od// spangs dang rtog pa'i yon tan gyi// cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla ba snang*// kun nas dkris pa'i bsreg bya dag /za byed ye shes me yi 'od// mtha' bral stong nyid ston pa'i sgras// smra ngan 'pham byed rnam rgyal dbyangs// gang la dad pa bskyed tsam gyis// rnam pa kun du bde mchog mdzad// lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu yi// skyabs gnas rmad byung mang po'i bla// srid par gnas kyang skyon med kyi// yon tan 'dab rgyas pad+ma'i sde// byang chub sbrang rtsi'i snying po can// 'gro la 'gyed pa pad+mo'i dbyangs// nges legs snying po'i bkren pa dag

/drung 'byin thabs kyi rin chen mang*// yang dag don ston log pa'i lam// mthar mdzad seng ge'i nga ro 'dzin// tshangs dbyangs mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gyis// sgra gzhan zil gnon seng ge'i dbyangs// byams pa'i cho gas bdud kyi dpung*// kun las rnam rgyal dpa' ba'i sde// mtshan ma yang dag blangs kun la// rnam par brgal ba the tshom gcod// rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba'i 'khor// rin po che dang me lta bu// mchog gi gnas las mi 'gyur ba'i// rnam kun lags ldan a sho ka /gya nom yon tan rdzogs pa'i rtser// son pa dam pa'i dga' ba ldan// lha dbang btud pa'i go 'phang du// 'dren mdzad dbang po'i 'byung ba'i gnas// dbyangs gcig rgyud las tha dad kyi// skad du legs 'doms dbyangs tshad med// rab 'byams mu med zhing khams su// snang bas 'gengs pa mar me mdzad// bsam kun rdzogs pa'i phrin las kyi// 'od zer kun khyab rin chen snang*// yon tan rgya mtsho'i zegs ma re// 'dzin pas re skong tshe dpag med// nyon mongs bdud kyi dpung tshogs las// dran pas rnam par rgyal ba mnga'// bdag med ston pa'i chos sgra yis// lta ngan drung 'byin rnam rgyal dbyangs// ci 'dod dpal gyi snying po dag /brtsegs pa rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal// mtshan tsam thos pas byang chub kyi// bar chad rdo rjes rab tu 'joms// srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kyi// mun pa sel ba rin chen me// phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i klung*// 'bebs mdzad bzang po dam pa'i dpal// byang chub yan lag phyogs kun nas// rdzogs pa'i bsil sbyin zla ba'i 'od// 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon// rab tu spangs pas pad+mor bzhugs// 'jig rten thams cad sku yi mtshan// gser gyi snang bas rnam par gnon// lta ba ngan pa'i ri bo dag /rab bsnyil ma pham pa yi dpal// sku gsum yon tan mdzad pa'i mtha'// tshad med bla ma bde gshegs rgyal// snying rje'i rlan dang bral ba rnams// 'dren mdzad ma brlan glang po'i mchog

/rtsol ba med par smon lam shugs// brtson 'grus grangs med zhugs pa'i dpal// gdul dka' chos la gzud pa'i thabs// bsam yas dgongs pa brjod mi lang*// tshul khrims dag pa'i lam mchog ston// gti mug med pa'i spos kyi dpal// sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan rnams// shin tu yongs gang zla ba'i dpal// mchog gi rin chen snang ba yis// sgrib sel rnam par mi rtog 'od// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun gyi// khyab bdag dam pa nam mkha' snang*// dmigs pa'i dug med snying rje yis// gzhan don spyod pa yang dag tog /'gro ba'i re skong yon tan gter// legs par gnas pa zhi ba'i rgyal// grangs med bskal pa'i rgya mtsho nas// dgongs pa'i don ni thams cad grub// rnam par 'byed pas dngos po kun// dbang gis mnga' mdzad shes rab sbed// gang 'dul mdzad pa bsam yas kyis// srid gsum yongs su dag par mdzad// grangs med bskal pa'i legs byas tshogs// baiḍūr+ya yi snying po mchog /khams gsum kun du yon tan gyi// rin po che yis rnam par gnon// bsam gyis mi khyab gsang ba yi// yon tan shin tu yang dag gnas// gang 'tsham sku yi rin chen gyi// snang bas gnon pa'i mchod rten che// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i mtha'// tshad med khrel yod gser mchog dpal// gdul bya'i rkang drug yongs kyi gnyen// pad+ma dam pa rnam par 'phrul// byang chub yan lag mi zad mdzod// rin chen dag pa 'byung ba'i dpal// lus can mi khom gnas las gdon// sangs rgyas glog 'od tog gi rgyal// mnyam nyid la gnas mnyam nyid ston// ta la'i rgyal po mngon 'phags dpal// mtha' yas 'gro la mtha' bral don// smra dbang nam mkha'i sgron ma che// mtshan tsam gyis kyang 'khor ba yi// gdung 'phrog yon tan thams cad 'byung*// gya nom yon tan gyis kun du// bzang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rgyal// mthong na rab dga'i dpal 'jo ba// rin chen kun brgyan gzugs mchog 'dzin/

༈ /sman bla'i mdo las 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan ni/ dpag yas thugs rje'i zil mngar gyis// nyon mongs bro 'joms sman gyi bla// mtshan bzang zla ba'i zer phreng gis// sa gsum mun 'phrogs mtshan legs dpal// chos rnams bdag med 'doms pa'i sgras// lta ngan drung 'byin sgra dbyangs rgyal// lus can srid tsho las gdon pa'i// mgon po gser bzang dri ma med// gang mtshan gling bu bsgyur tsam gyis// ngan 'gro rnam sbyong mya ngan med// legs gsungs nyi mas 'jig rten khams// snang byed chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dpal// sgrib bral ye shes me long du// dngos kun rnam gsal mngon mkhyen rgyal/ ༈ /rgyal ba'i yum las 'byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan ni/ shar phyogs 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// rgyal sras blo gros kun 'byung ba// lho phyogs 'jig rten dge ba'i dpal// sems dpa' mya ngan med pas byin// nub phyogs 'jig rten zhing sbyong ba'i// rgyal sras spyod pa'i blo gros dpal// byang phyogs 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gnyen// sangs rgyas myu gu rgyal bas byin// dbang ldan 'jig rten khams kyi dpal// rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon// me mtshams 'jig rten 'dren pa'i bshes// rgyal sras lag na pad+mas mtshan// bden bral 'jig rten khams bzhugs nas// phan mdzad nyi ma rab tu snang*// rlung mtshams 'jig rten khams la brten// gzhan don khur khyer rin chen mchog /'og phyogs 'jig rten snang byed cing*// brtse ba'i spyan yangs pad+mo mchog /steng phyogs 'jig rten zhing rab bskyangs// sems can smin mdzad dga' bas byin// rgyal sras spyod pa'i blo gros dpal/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi mtshan ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes gzugs// ma rig drung 'byin 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'gro la gzigs pa'i snying rje'i spyan// ring por spros pa pad dkar 'chang*// rnam 'dren kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod// yongs 'dzin lag na rdo rje can// ma 'dris 'gro la ci 'dod kyi// re ba rdzogs mdzad sa yi snying*// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin pas kyang*// las nyon sgrib pa rnam sel byed// skye bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung rnams// dran pas 'dag byed kha gar+bha// dga' ldan bzhugs pa'i chos rnga che// bskal bzang sems dpa' mi pham mgon// snying stobs rmad byung rnam par thar// gang gis bsgrun min kun du bzang*/

༈ /rgyal ba'i bka' don rnam par 'grel ba'i mkhas grub kyi slob dpon chen po rags btus rnams kyi mtshan ni/ thub pa'i zhal lung rin chen mdzod// yongs 'dzin dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /thub pa'i mgrin las rtsa rgyud kyi// bdud rtsi nod pa zla ba bzang*// zur phud lnga ldan zlos pa'i gar// rig ldan thog ma 'jam dbyangs grags// gsang rgyud rtse mo dus 'khor lo// rgya chen 'grel byed pad+ma dkar// bde gshegs sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur rnam grol 'byung po'i dbang*// gsang chen nor bu'i gces mdzod 'dzin// klu gyur ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// rgyal gsung gsang ba mi zad mdzod// yongs 'dzin bi su kalpar grags// thub dbang bka' don rang stobs kyis// 'grel byed 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag don// smra ba'i skyes mchog 'phags pa lha// phyugs skyong lus kyis bden gnyis don// yang dag gzigs pa klu'i byang chub// phyi dang nang gi grub pa'i gzhung*// rgya mtsho smra ba pha khol zhabs// rgyud 'grel sgron ma gsal ba'i 'od// ring du spro ba zla grags zhabs// rgyan bdun rgya yis bcings pa'i rgyud// ji bzhin 'grel mdzad legs ldan byed// byams pas rjes bzung legs gsung gi /bdud rtsi yongs 'dzin thogs med zhabs// mkha' 'gros dbang bskur nub bdun nas// sa drug mngon gyur bi rū pa// gdams pa zab mo'i bcud len gyis// 'chi med grub pa kah+ṇa pa// kun du rmongs pa'i 'tsho rgyun dag /gcod pa'i mthu ldan ḍom+bhi ka /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel don// zab mos thugs grol ḍā ma ru// bus pa'i spyod pas sems can khams// yongs su smin byed dbu ma pa// gsang chen rgyud kyi sbas pa'i don// rnam par 'grel pa 'byung po'i dbang*// rgya mtsho las 'khrungs phyag rgya che'i// dngos grub brnyes pa mtsho skyes zhabs// tshe gcig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sa// mngon gyur yan lag med rdo rje// zab mo'i lam bstan rnam grol mchog

/mngon gyur dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhabs// bden gnyis mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// gzung 'dzin snying 'bigs ri khrod mgon// rdo rje'i tshig gis bcings pa'i rgyud// 'grel byed bha wa bha dra'i zhabs// dzā lan+dha rar skye bdun rdzas// bsten pas rnam grol sbyang dka' zla// dbang bzhis legs smin nub gsum gyis// sbyor lam mchog 'khrungs ga ya dhṛka /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug gi /gtsug na ngal gso sa ra ha// zab mo'i lam gyis sprul 'tshong bcas// dngos grub mchog brnyes dā ri ka /snang srid lhan skyes ye shes kyi// rol par legs mthong dril bu pa// sna tshogs thabs kyi khyad par brten// chos mig rab gsal ti lo pa// sham+bha la nas dus 'khor lo// dang por 'dren mdzad tsi lu pa// rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don// mgrin las 'jo ba dpe med 'tsho// rnam dpyod snyim pas gsang chen klung*// bzhes nas 'bebs mdzad pi to pa// rgyud chen dgongs pa tshogs gsum gyi// lam nas smra ba dus zhabs che// phyi nang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don// smra mkhas dpal bzang byang chub zhabs// ut+pal sngo ldan gnas lnga rig /smra ba'i tshul bzung 'jam dbyangs grags// dngos kun bde ba chen po'i gar// legs mthong slob pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs// kun yid 'gugs pa'i legs bshad kyi// mtshar sdug ngom pa skal ldan grags// bde 'byung dka' 'grel pad+ma can// 'jig rten snang byed rin chen bsrungs// gsang mtha'i rgyud don 'grel pa'i blo// lhag pa'i lhas byin ye shes sde// sems can re ba rtag 'jo ba'i// yon tan rmad byung koṅga dā// rnam 'phrul du mas gzhan don mdzad// gnas lnga rig mchog smṛ ti dz+nyā// yang dag sbyor 'grel man ngag gi /snye ma smin byed 'jigs med 'byung*// byang chub sems gnyis rgyud sbyangs nas// gzhan don gzhol ba dri med bzang*// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu gter la// dbang 'byor slob dpon kuk+ku rī// 'phags ma dgyes pa'i zhal sgo nas// lung bstan mchog brnyes nyi ma sbas// gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i de nyid gzigs// legs par smra ba ku mā raḥ

/'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje'i phreng*// rgya cher 'grel pa a laṃ ka /ye shes ral gris sgrib gsum gyi// drwa ba bcad pa shākya bshes// phyag na pad+ma'i zhal gyi zla// legs mthong ma ti gar+bha ka /rim gnyis rdo rje'i gom stabs kyis// mchog gi grong gshegs sa 'dres pa// zab mo'i mthar thug gsang chen rgyud// gsal mdzad sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan uḍ+yan nas// rgyud chen spyan 'dren la li taḥ /lhag pa'i lhas bskul bstan bcos brtsams// bar dor mchog grub ye shes zhabs// ye shes spyan gyis chos nyid don// bden mthong dbang po ba lin+taḥ// kun dkris bong ba shes rab mtshon// rnon pos dral ba tog tse ba// sngags rig rgyal po 'dus pa'i rgyan// kun du snang byed zla ba'i 'od// rim gnyis lam gyi shing rtar brten// sku bzhi'i grong gshegs dpal bde ba// legs par bshad pas mang thos kun// rab dga'i 'byung gnas go cha'i zhabs// theg chen gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don// legs mthong dad byed go cha'i zhabs// skye 'dir srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis las// rnam grol brnyes pa mar me mdzad// mkhyen pa'i gaṇ+ḍ+rar 'khor 'das kyi// ri mo rnam gsal tsi lu pa// bden gnyis rtogs pa'i mtsho chen las// legs bshad rgyun 'bebs kun du bzang*// zab gsang bstan pa'i snang byed che// smra dbang rin chen rdo rje'i zhabs// gnas lnga rig pa'i blo gros mig /rnam par gsal ba bita pā dāḥ /cir snang dngos po bde chen gyi// rol par rab gzigs wī ra ḍiḥ /'phags yul lnga rig smra kun gyi// gtsug rgyan chen po dpal 'dzin zhabs// legs gsungs snang ba'i rnam 'byed kyi// 'od ris rnam gsal la ti taḥ /bden gnyis 'byed pa'i blo gros mig /rab gsal bi ma la mi tra// pha rol rgol ba kun las rgyal// shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs// snang srid 'khrul ba chos dbyings su// shar ba'i glu len bi rū pa// lhan skyes bde ba chen po las// brtsams pa'i glu len zhi ba'i lha// longs spyod 'khor lo grol ba las// gdams pa kun 'byung kam+pa la// rab gsal zla bas rjes su bzung*// rdo rje'i sa gshegs sgra gcan 'dzin// rgyud 'grel ko sa la yi rgyan// rtsom pa'i slob dpon shākya bshes// rnam snang mngon par byang chub rgyud// rgyas 'grel byed po sangs rgyas gsang*// 'phags ma'i zhal mthong rnal 'byor rgyud// gsal ba'i nyi ma kun dga' snying*// rtog ge'i yul min gsang ba'i sngags// smra mkhas ye shes rdo rje'i zhabs// rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsal// rab rdzogs pradz+nyā bo dhī'i zhabs// nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims dri// kun khyab bde ba'i rdo rje 'dzin// mkhyen yangs tshangs pa'i ral pa las// legs bshad rgyun 'bebs rab zhi bshes// gsang chen chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang sgyur zhi ba'i snying po'i zhabs// thar pa'i mchog gi 'bras bu nyid// lam byed smra mkhas dge mtshan bshes// lha mchog zhal gzigs che mchog gi

/yon tan lnga ldan 'jam dpal grags// gsang chen rgyud sde 'grel pa'i blo// dri med zla bzang grags pa'i dpal// gsang chen rgyud sdes bstan bya'i bcud// smra dbang rdo rje go cha'i zhabs// rgyud don rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyas// bcings pa rnam grol lha sbas mtshan// rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor phreng*// tshar du dngar byed 'jigs med 'byung*// legs sbyar gtam gyis mur 'dug gi /log smra tshar gcod tsan+d+ra pa// brda sprod smra ba'i gtsug tor tog /rgyal bas lung bstan pā ṇi ni// gdong drug zhal gzigs brda sprod gzhung*// kun mkhyen dbang phyug go cha brnyes// brda sprod rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// smra dbang durga siṃ ha'i zhabs// gnas lnga rig pa'i 'od stong gis// bstan pa'i snang byed drag 'byor bzang*// tshar gcod rjes bzung rig pa'i gzhung*// smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal grags// brda sprod gzhung brgya 'byed pa'i blo// lhag pa'i lhas byin thams cad 'dzin// ming dang rtags kyi legs sbyar mdzod// byed po 'chi med seng ge'i zhabs// mkhas pa 'chi med las byung ba'i// bstan bcos 'grel mdzad rab 'byor zla// tshangs sras dgyes pa'i mgrin pa las// brda sprod mnos pa rjes 'byor bzang*// brda sprod smra ba yongs kyi mig /bram ze ba la bha drar grags// bro nad 'joms pa'i gso dpyad gzhung*// zhu byed rig pa'i ye shes che// shes rab sgron mes mtha' 'khob kyi// mun sel bo dhi satwa'i zhabs// bod yul dam chos dbu brnyes pa'i// thog ma'i rje bo tho ri gnyen// lung dang rigs pa'i gnam lcags lces// lta ngan ri bsnyil ka ma la// pad dkar 'chang ba sa spyod kyi// rnam par rol pa srong btsan rje// bsil ldan dge legs 'gugs pa'i drin// mtshungs med pad+mā ka ra'i zhabs// 'jam dpal sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba 'dul mdzad khri srong mtshan// ming tshig yi ge'i shing rtar brten// chos kyi skyes 'dren sam+bho ṭa// chos kyi nyi mas bsil ldan ljongs// gsal byed lo tsā rin chen bzang*// gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal srid la// mkhyen pas mnga' mdzad sa skya pa// mkhyen rab nor bus bstan pa'i rnyog

/legs bgrungs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// mkhas btsun grub pa mchog gi rtser// rab gshegs bkra shis lhun gyis grub// rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi// khyab bdag dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs/ ༈ /rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas bstan pa'i yi dam gyi lha rags btus rnams kyi mtshan ni/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gis// srid zhir dbang mdzad he badz+ra// brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa'i// khyab bdag chen po thugs rdo rje// chos kun skye 'gags gnas pa yi// stong nyid ston pa gsung rdo rje// bsam gyis mi khyab gsang gsum gyi// yon tan rten byed sku rdo rje// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyis// 'khor 'das kun khyab rdo rje gur// rnam pa kun mchog bde ba che// stong nyid kha sbyor rdo rje dbyings// kun mchog bde ba chen po yis// srid gsum dbang mdzad dus 'khor lo// bde stong gnyis su med pa'i dbyings// srid zhi mnyam sbyor bde ba'i mchog /dbang sngon lhun po mtshams sprin gyis// 'khyud pa'i dpal 'phrog bde ba'i mchog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtshar sdug gi /sgyu 'phrul rol pa dbyangs can lha// srid pa'i sgyu ma bde chen gyi// sgyu mas 'jig mdzad sgyu ma che// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhan skyes kyi// bde bar sdom mdzad sam+bā ra// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bskyed pa'i yum gyur wā ra hī// ye shes sgron mes ma rig pa'i// mun pa drung 'byin phag mo dkar// sgrub la dngos grub mi zad rgyun// rtag 'jo rdo rje gdan bzhi pa// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan mdzod// gcig gyur 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rnam 'dren gyi// gsang gsum kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs// ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje yis// sgrib pa'i dpung 'joms gshin rje'i gshed// las nyon sgrib pa'i dgra sde las// rnam par rgyal byed ya mā ri// bdud 'dul khro bo kun gyi gtso// dus dgra badz+ra bhai ra wa// bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms dpa' bo che// gdong pa drug ldan khro bo'i rgyal// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus pa// bskyed pa'i yab gyur mañdzu shrī// dga' ldan skye bo'i don mdzad pa'i// rgyal tshab chen po ma pham pa// bya grub ye shes mtshar sdug gi

/sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sgrol mdzad ma// mthu stobs rmad byung rdo rje yis// log 'dren mthar byed 'byung po 'dul// kun mkhyen ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// bgegs 'dul khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// mthu stobs mchog gi rdo rje yis// bgegs dpung mthar byed khro bo'i rgyal// bdud bzhi sder bcas 'dul ba po// 'jigs byed chen po mi g.yo mgon// stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi mthu// rmad byung gcig bsdus gsang ba'i bdag /skyon bral pad+ma'i rigs kyi lha// bgegs 'joms rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// thugs rje'i sman gyis srid pa'i rims// 'joms mdzad rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil// 'gag med gsung gi rdo rje yis// chos kun glu len rdo rje chos// mtshan rtog sgrib pa'i dgra tshogs kyis// gzhom du med pa rdo rje dbyings// mkhyen brtse'i klung gis ngan 'gro'i dri// rnam par sbyong ba thams cad rig /gang gi gsang gsum bsgom bzlas kyis// 'chi med sbyin pa rdo rje tshe// mthu stobs rdo rjes bgegs kyi dpung*// phyer 'thags 'jig rten gsum las rgyal// gdug pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo che// rig pa'i rgyal po me ltar 'bar// 'di mtshan su zhig rna ba'i snod// lhung bas don byed mi 'khrugs pa// 'chi med dngos grub lam gsum rgyun// 'gro rgyud 'bebs pa tshe mtha' yas// rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi// mchog sbyin shes rab pha rol phyin// 'od mtha' yas pa'i de bzhin gshegs// yid 'phrog skus rtsen rnam rgyal ma// rnam mkhyen yongs kyi nus pa'i rtsal// gcig bsdus rdo rje rnam par 'joms// yang dag don mthong ye shes kyi// snang ba'i dpal skyed 'jam pa'i dbyangs// snying rje chen po'i zla snang gis// 'khor ba'i gdung 'khrog bsil ldan mgon// ngan 'gro srid pa'i duḥkha las// 'gro ba 'don mdzad don yod zhags// thugs rje'i zla bas 'gro khams kyi// gdung ba bsil byed mkha' spyod lha// mi mthun rgud pa'i sgra ngan phyogs// rnam par 'joms byed seng ge'i sgra// thugs rje myur ba'i dpag bsam gyis// 'gro ba'i re skong sgrol ma ljang*// ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che'i// grong khyer bdag po 'jam pa'i dpal// gsang gsum byin rlabs 'od po ches// 'chi ba'i mun 'joms tshe dpag med// thugs rje'i zla ba gzhu khams kyis// tshe dpal bskyed pa'i sgrol ma dkar// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po yi// gtsug tor las 'khrungs gdugs dkar mo// gnas skabs mthar thug 'jig rten gyi// dge legs spel ma so sor 'brang*// sems can kun gyi dug gsum nad// yongs su 'phrog ma rma bya che// dus gsum rnam 'dren ma lus pa// bskyed pa'i ma gcig gsang sngags 'dzin// gang gi thugs rjes lus can gyi// mi mthun phyogs 'joms bsil ba'i tshal// 'jig rten khams su bde legs grogs// 'gugs mdzad stong chen rab tu 'byams// gang mtshan lan gcig brjod pas kyang*// bde ba'i dpal sbyin 'od zer can/

༈ /'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mtshan ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan dgra bcom che// smra ngan las rgyal yan lag 'byung*// zag pa'i dgra sde mngon bcom nas// gzhan don phun tshogs ma pham pa// 'gro ba srid pa'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol ba'i blo brtan nags na gnas// kun mkhyen gsung gi bdud rtsi yis// rnam par grol ba dus ldan zhabs// chos min spyod pa'i rgyal srid spangs// skyabs 'os rdo rje mo yi bu// ston pas legs bskul rab tu byung*// zag pa'i dgra bcom bzang po pa// dge mtshan rjes 'brangs bstan pa la// legs bzhugs dgra bcom gser be'u// ci 'dod gser gyi lag pas stsol// bhā ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /rnam gzigs 'khor du sman gyis mchod// rtag tu bde thob ba ku la// byang sems srid pa tha ma pa'i// sras 'khrungs 'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin// rdul spangs dri ma spangs pa'i don// legs rtogs dgra bcom lam phran brten// las mtha' sbyang phyir bsod nams brten// bhā ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// nyin mtshan khor yug klog pa dang*// sgrub pas rnam grol lam chen brten// rgyal srid dkar min bya ba yis// yid 'byung zag zad klu yi sde// dad pa'i rtsa brtan zag zad kyi// 'bras bu smin pa sbed byed pa// snying rjer ldan pa yongs kyi phul// ston pas bsngags pa mi phyed pa// kun mkhyen gyis gsungs mang thos kyi// sgra 'dzin ches yangs kun dga' bo// dgra bcom 'phags pa dgyes pa'i las// lhur len dharma tā la'i mtshan// thub gsung gsal ba'i shes rab mig /dkyus ring spros pa shā ri'i bu// ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul bgrang yas kyis// 'gro 'dul dgra bcom maung gal bu// chos kun rnam 'byed 'khor lo yis// chos mngon sdud mdzad 'od srungs che// ston pas legs bcas bslab pa'i gnas// gus pa lhur len nor sbyin 'dzin// chos 'dul bstan pa'i chu klung dag

/sdud mdzad dbang po nye ba 'khor// lkog 'gyur blta ba'i rdzu 'phrul mig /dri med yangs pa ma 'gags pa// rgyal bas byin brlabs 'dri ba dang*// lan ldon tshig gi rab tu 'byor// ston par chos 'khor bskor bskul bar// smon lam gyis sbrel gser mngal can// thub mchog la gus bdud rtsi'i chos// mang thos bden mthong kau shi ka ༈ /chos skyong nor lha rags btus rnams kyi mtshan ni/ rnam 'dren bstan pa srid mtha'i bar// nyams med skyongs shig nag po che// rgyud sde bzhi yi bshad sgrub las// rgyas par mdzod cig bram ze'i gzugs// bstan pa srung zhing bstan 'dzin gyi// bar chad bzlog cig re wa tī// gsang chen rgyud kyi bshad sgrub las// rgyas par mdzod cig myur mdzad mgon// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi// char 'bebs mgon po yid bzhin nor// ut+pal mig gi zur mda' yis// srid gsum brtan 'phrog rig byed ma// 'dod dgu'i nor gyi dga' ston mkhan// gter bdag dbang po dzam+bha la// dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo// 'byed pa'i lha mo nor rgyun ma// bdud rtsi'i chos thos bden pa mthong*// dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan bstan pa skyong*// grul bum dbang phyug 'phags skyes po// legs gsungs rgya mtsho skyong bar khas// 'ches pa'i klu bdag mig mi bzang*// chos mdzad dbul ba'i gdung 'phrog mkhan// gnod sbyin sde dpon rnam thos sras// mngon shes drug ldan rnam par 'dren// rgyal sras slob mar bcas tshogs kyi// mtshan mchog yi ge bzhad pa'i sgras// bde rab ster bzod thugs rje'i gter// de dag kun gyi spyan snga ru// dbyig 'dzin rdul phran chu gter thigs// gaṅgā'i bye snyed bdag gzhan lus// grangs med sprul pa'i thal sbyar btud// byung dang 'byung 'gyur da ltar bcas// bsags pa'i dge lus longs spyod rnams// 'dzad med bskal pa'i phreng 'jo ba'i// mchod sprin sprul pas mdun bdar nas// skye ba lu gu rgyud nas brtsam// mngon gyur bcas pa'i sdig ltung rnams// stobs bzhis bshags pa'i mdun na de// skad cig gnyis par bsgyings mi bzod// srid zhi'i legs byas mkha'i rna ba// gang dag shar la yi rang gi

/gnyis skyes gzhon nu'i smra sgo nas// rus pa'i ge sar 'dzum bsu bzhin// khams gsum 'gro 'dul spros pa'i sku// dbyings su rtul bzhad ci dgar byos// slad nas sngon gyi smon lam shugs// dran bskul gang tshe 'gyod mi 'tshal// mtha' gnyis ma lhung lam gang gis// khyed cag bde bar gshegs shul nas// sdug bsngal kun 'byung gis gtses rnams// bkri phyir 'gog lam 'doms par gsol// de tshul rtun pa'i dge bas mtshon// rnam par gnag min las thams cad// khams gsum skye bor legs gsungs dbyangs// lhun grub 'byung ba'i rgyur phyir bsngo// skyabs su dkon mchog gsum bzung ba// kho bo ltos bcas sems can rnams// byang chub bar gyi skye ba'i phreng*// dal brgyad 'byor bcur dbang 'byor mdzod// srid snang nags khrod dbang shes kyi// yal ga'i ri dwags mi zhen par// nges 'byung thar pa'i snye ma dag /gzhan phan lang tsho'i bcud len mdzod// theg gsum bstan pa'i smra mkhas las// chos 'dul legs thos bslab pa'i gnas// yid srubs sprul pas mi 'drid par// nyes med bsil ba'i bde thob mdzod// snying rje rnam rgyas thub pa'i bu// gzhan don spyod pa'i khur chen khyer// stong nyid snying rjes gom rlabs kyis// dpag yas spyod mthar phyin par mdzod// sngags rig 'chang gi ded dpon des// lta bsgom spyod grus tshogs zung mtsho// skad cig gcig brgal mchog dngos kyi// yid bzhin nor bu brnyes par mdzod// sku gsum yon tan mi zad rgyan// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dpag yas kyis// gzhan don mdzad pa lhun grub dang*// rgyun chags mkha' mnyam nyid byin rlobs// 'jig rten snying po mi mchog rnams kyi mtshan gyi rnga bo che ldir ba// thos 'dzin bcud du bsten nam klog gam 'dzin par lhur byed de de'i rgyud// bsod nams bye ba'i 'bab stegs byed 'gyur gdams pa'i bden pas 'gro 'di rnams// ngan 'gro srid pa'i duḥkha za ba'i rgyal por byin gyis rlobs shig kye// zhes mi mchog rnams kyi mtshan rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bka' lung gi dgongs 'grel 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dbu lha'i dgos ched dang dwang 'dod chab cig par ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba ka l+yā ṇa bha wa tu//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
